entries.clue: Fussy, drawn-out procedure for something that ought to take a minute
Flint's title, and the one whose word is law on a ship's quarterdeck
Green bird of Long John's, screeching the same three words for ever
Boxy holiday home towed behind the family car, blocking the road for miles
Toasted round riddled with holes that drink up the butter
One-person booth walled on three sides, for work nobody may interrupt
Grown-up: said of the half of the building the pushchairs keep out of
One who feeds a crew, and the post a one-legged schemer signed on under
Panelled cubbyhole off the main bar, frosted glass and a hatch for orders
Device that turns a screenful into sheets, at a few pence each
Flap in the outside wall for bringing things back after closing time
Piece fired half an hour before sundown as the signal to come aboard
